title: A unified approach to infinite log-concavity of combinatorial sequences
summary: We establish a sufficient condition for infinite log-concavity and apply it to five families of combinatorial sequences. We give a new proof of infinite log-concavity for the Boros--Moll coefficient sequences $(d_k(n))_{k=0}^n$ for fixed $n$. For the transposed sequences $(d_\ell(\ell+k))_{k\ge0}$, we prove Zhao's conjecture on infinite log-concavity for every fixed integer $\ell\ge3$.
